The case runs ORD-001 → ORD-005 → ORD-017 → ORD-023 → ORD-011, which is four hops. ORD-011 is the final order and its status is shipped.

At the ORD-023 hop, the note says the case continues to whichever of ORD-011 and ORD-027 never shipped. ORD-027 left on time, so I took ORD-011 as the one that didn't ship. ORD-011's own note points to ORD-014, but that would be a fifth hop, so I stopped there.

<answer>ORD-011,shipped</answer>
